description: Get detail for a Bilibili video by BVID, optionally fetching subtitles.

bvid.description: Bilibili video ID (BVID) to look up.

fetch_subtitles.description: Whether to fetch subtitles for the video.

subtitle_cid.description: Subtitle CID to use, overriding the CID for the selected page.

subtitle_lang.description: Subtitle language code of the track to select.

subtitle_max_chars.description: Maximum number of subtitle characters to return.

subtitle_mode.description: Subtitle track selection mode: best or first (default best).

subtitle_page.description: Video page number to fetch subtitles for (default 1).

subtitle_scope.description: Subtitle scope: all, or metadata for track metadata only (default all).

name: get_video_detail
